notes: Fund-clearing loop 2026-10-19 (t7a). Same filer behaviour as TCW Direct Lending VIII (D-206, D-208), each item checked on this fund's pages. Net assets: the filer tags the paid-in line 'Common Unitholders capital' as us-gaap:MembersCapital and the printed 'Total Members Capital' as us-gaap:MembersEquity; the shared order read the paid-in line (the same figure repeated for four and five quarters: 721,083 and 716,388 thousand), so every quarter is set from the printed Total Members Capital. Investments: 'Total Debt & Equity Investments' (excluding the money market fund and the Treasury bills) is the basis of the filed figures where one is filed; it is set where none is. Income: the filer tags total investment income as us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNet (10-Q 2026-03-31: 'Total investment income 19,690 29,477', tagged InvestmentIncomeNet 19,690,000), which the shared map read as net investment income (printed 'Net investment income 11,422 54,734', tagged NetInvestmentIncome); interest expense is the printed 'Interest and credit facilities expenses' (InterestAndDebtExpense, 3,403 thousand), while the map published the directors' fee or the repurchase-transaction interest. InterestExpenseDebt* facts are the credit-facility note's components and are suppressed as in AGL. NAV per unit is printed on the accrual base ('Net Asset Value Per Unit (accrual base) equates to the aggregate of the Total Members' Capital and Common Unitholders' undrawn commitment'), so it is not net assets divided by units; left as filed.
